slice: S5-D — Angular Host Ownership & Selector Compatibility Decision
type: Architecture Decision Record (read-only; NO production changes)
authorization: Lead S5-D directive: GO for a read-only architectural decision increment. Investigate public API exposure, release history, selector alternatives (Rename 'smilodon-angular-select' / attribute selector / isolated core entry), compatibility policy, and the minimal production diff + exact tests to close F02. Produce an ADR in Markdown + JSON. NO production implementation authorized. Preferred direction: selector divergence (Option A), but the rename is NOT yet authorized — compatibility consequences must be established first.
status: PROPOSED — awaits Lead acceptance of the selector compatibility decision
problemStatement: F02 (CONFIRMED production defect, S5-VR): the Angular adapter's host selector `smilodon-select` collides with core's `NativeSelectElement` custom element (`packages/core/src/components/native-select.ts:562-563`). When the deferred `import('@smilodon/core')` runs, the custom element upgrades the Angular host, `attachShadow({mode:'open'})` is called WITHOUT a <slot>, and the light-DOM `<enhanced-select>` (the real widget) is excluded from the composed rendering tree — 0x0, invisible, unhittable, unfocusable. The widget internals still function; it is the host wrapper that suppresses them. This affects BOTH CSR and SSR consumers (it is an adapter architecture defect, not SSR-specific).

publicApiExposure.publicExports: packages/angular/src/index.ts exports SmilodonSelectComponent (standalone) — the selector IS the public integration contract for every Angular consumer
publicApiExposure.notReferencedByUnitTests: packages/angular/tests/*.spec.ts instantiate `new SmilodonSelectComponent()` with a mocked ElementRef and assert on the INNER `enhanced-select` tag (select.component.test.ts:70) — the host tag name is NEVER asserted, so a rename is invisible to the 62 unit tests
publicApiExposure.declaredByCore: packages/core/src/components/native-select.ts:562-563 registers the custom element `smilodon-select` (NativeSelectElement) as a top-level side effect of the full core entry
publicApiExposure.alternativesFree: `smilodon-angular-select` is unused across the repo (only a doc suggestion mentions it); no `smilodonSelect` attribute selector exists

releaseHistory.npmRegistry: npm view @smilodon/angular → 404 Not Found (NOT currently published on npm)
releaseHistory.changelog: Root CHANGELOG.md states 'Angular support has been discontinued as of December 2025 … @smilodon/angular is now deprecated on npm', with a historical commit `c4248e0 refactor: Remove Angular support completely`
releaseHistory.revival: The current branch REVIVED packages/angular from scratch: `b972cd7 feat(angular): S1 package scaffold` (Wave-2 program). The version field is 1.13.0 (carried from the historical line) but the package is a development/unpublished artifact.
releaseHistory.conclusion: The current `smilodon-select` Angular selector is NOT an established, in-the-wild public API. The package is effectively PRE-RELEASE (unpublished, revived after a removal). A selector rename carries NO installed-base breakage cost at this time.

siblingAdapters.finding: ALL other Smilodon adapters host the real `<enhanced-select>` element DIRECTLY (no wrapper custom element):

evidence.playground: playground/src/scenarios.ts → document.createElement('smilodon-select') (uses the core native element directly, NOT the Angular adapter)

siblingAdapters.significance: The Angular adapter is the ONLY one that wraps the widget in a colliding host element. The collision is a deviation from the established sibling pattern; the fix aligns Angular with the others (host the real element, with an adapter-owned, non-colliding host name).

coreRegistrationSideEffects.fact: Importing the full `@smilodon/core` entry registers THREE custom elements: `smilodon-select` (NativeSelectElement), `enhanced-select`, `select-option`.
coreRegistrationSideEffects.implicationForD03: If the Angular host is renamed (Option A) or made an attribute selector (Option D), full-core import still registers `smilodon-select`, but it no longer matches the Angular host → the widget cannot be hidden. So D-03 ('full core imports cannot hide the Angular widget') is satisfiable WITHOUT a core change, because the collision requires the host to be NAMED `smilodon-select`.

A.name: Selector divergence (rename)
A.hostOwnership: Unambiguous — the Angular element owns a name no core element registers (D-01 satisfied)
A.fullCoreImport: Full core still registers `smilodon-select`, but the Angular host is a different tag → widget cannot be hidden (D-03 satisfied without core change)
A.minimalProductionDiff: ONE line: select.component.ts:106 selector change. Plus doc/comment updates. NO logic change: ElementRef still resolves to the component host (new tag); @ViewChild('host') still finds the inner <enhanced-select>; :host styles and focus tracking are tag-agnostic.
A.consumerImpact: Templates change `<smilodon-select>` → `<smilodon-angular-select>`. Pre-release → no installed-base breakage; README + consumer + SSR fixtures updated.
A.compatibility: Breaking to the (unpublished) template surface only — but there is no released surface.

B.name: Shadow-root slot injection
B.sketch: Adapter injects a <slot> into the foreign shadow root at runtime
B.hostOwnership: Ambiguous — Angular depends on the private DOM of another component (violates D-01 spirit)
B.foreignShadowRoot: Directly DEPENDENT on the foreign shadow root → violates D-02
B.verdict: REJECTED — couples Angular to NativeSelectElement internals; foreign listbox/ARIA/event semantics remain

C.name: Isolated core entry (enhanced-select only)
C.sketch: Adapter imports a core sub-entry that registers only `enhanced-select`, avoiding `smilodon-select` registration
C.hostOwnership: Still ambiguous if the host keeps `smilodon-select` — a consumer that independently imports full core re-registers the colliding element (D-03 fails for mixed consumers)
C.scope: Requires core package architecture changes (new entry point) → expands beyond the adapter; risks mixed-import registration divergence
C.verdict: NOT SUFFICIENT ALONE — does not solve D-03 for applications that import full core independently; would be a core-architecture change (D-10 risk)

D.name: Attribute selector
D.hostOwnership: Unambiguous — attribute on an Angular-owned element (D-01 satisfied)
D.fullCoreImport: `smilodon-select` element never present → no collision (D-03 satisfied)
D.downside: Changes the consumer integration contract more than a rename (element + attribute mental model); styling via :host still works but the public usage shape is less element-like and diverges further from the sibling adapters (which are element-shaped)
D.verdict: VIABLE ALTERNATIVE — satisfies invariants, but a larger consumer-contract change than Option A and less consistent with the other element-based adapters

rationale: Satisfies D-01, D-02, D-03 with NO core change and NO foreign-shadow dependency.
Aligns the Angular adapter with the sibling adapters' pattern (adapter owns a non-colliding host that renders the real <enhanced-select>).
Minimal production diff (one-line selector change + docs); zero logic change; zero unit-test change.
Pre-release status means no installed-base compatibility cost for a direct rename.

Option B is architecturally unsound; Option C is insufficient for mixed consumers and expands into core; Option D is viable but a larger contract change and less consistent with the element-based siblings.
decision.notYetAuthorized: The rename itself is NOT authorized in S5-D. This ADR proposes it and spells out the exact production diff and tests; the Lead must accept the selector compatibility decision before F02 remediation is executed.
decision.fallbackIfContractPreservationMandated: Option D (attribute selector) — kept on record as the invariants-satisfying alternative if the Lead prefers a host the adapter fully controls without a new custom-element-looking tag.

compatibilityPolicy.policy: DIRECT REPLACEMENT is acceptable: rename the selector to `smilodon-angular-select` with no deprecation shim and no migration tooling, because there is no published/installed surface to preserve.
compatibilityPolicy.versionImpact: At publication time, follow semver for the unpublished package; since nothing was ever released under the colliding selector, publish the corrected selector as the initial public shape (no major bump owed to consumers).
compatibilityPolicy.migrationMechanism: Not required. If a migration aid is desired for internal forks, document the one-line template rename; no runtime compatibility alias will be provided (an alias would reintroduce the colliding `smilodon-select` host).
compatibilityPolicy.note: Do NOT keep `smilodon-select` as an alias for the Angular component — an alias would re-introduce the exact tag collision this decision exists to eliminate.

minimalProductionDiff.note: No logic change. ElementRef still targets the component host; @ViewChild('host') still resolves the inner <enhanced-select>; focus tracking + :host styles are tag-agnostic.

minimalProductionDiff.change: update JSDoc example (lines ~97-102) and code comments (335, 944, 1056) to the new tag

minimalProductionDiff.note: test fixture; SSR serialized markup tag changes accordingly

explicitlyNotChanged: core-loader.ts deferred core import (unchanged; still loads full core which harmlessly registers `smilodon-select`)
the 62 unit tests (they instantiate the class directly and are host-tag-agnostic)

flipExpectedFailuresToPasses: hydration.spec.ts → 'tag collision does NOT hide the real widget (visible, sized, hittable)'  — remove test.fail(); widget must be visible with >0 box; combobox must be clickable (Playwright actionability)
hydration.spec.ts → 'collision does NOT suppress layout (host + widget have real geometry)'       — remove test.fail(); enhClientRects>0, width/height>0, hitInsideWidget
hydration.spec.ts → 'REAL focus cannot reach the widget while it is unrendered (F02 consequence)' — remove test.fail(); real .focus() must move document.activeElement into the combobox (shadow-aware)
exactTestsToCloseF02.alsoUpdate: F01 node-reuse stamp must now target `smilodon-angular-select` (not `smilodon-select`) so node identity is still verified on the renamed host; SSR serialized-region assertions reflect the new tag
exactTestsToCloseF02.mustNot: Do NOT delete or weaken assertions. The three F02 tests must become genuine PASSES, not removed. Additionally address watchpoints W01–W06 during production qualification.

watchpointFollowups.W01: Replace 'foreign shadow root has a slot' assertion with implementation-independent visibility/geometry assertions (the slot check is defect-mechanism-specific and must not gate the fixed state).
watchpointFollowups.W02: Focus test must use shadow-aware activeElement traversal (walk composed path / shadowRoot.activeElement chain), not a direct document.activeElement === innerElement comparison.
watchpointFollowups.W03: Initial forms test must assert formChanges === 0 exactly (currently collected but not asserted).
watchpointFollowups.W04: Output test must assert EXACTLY one event per intended selection (changeCount === 1), not '>=1'.
watchpointFollowups.W05: F03 must use genuine pointer + keyboard interactions against the real widget once rendered (not programmatic container.click()).
watchpointFollowups.W06: Real focus-loss/touched must be exercised via genuine browser focus transitions (tab/blur to an outside element), not synthetic FocusEvent only.

D-01.satisfiedBy: Option A: Angular owns `smilodon-angular-select`, a tag no core element registers

D-02.requirement: No dependency on a foreign shadow root
D-02.satisfiedBy: Option A: nothing upgrades `smilodon-angular-select`; adapter touches only its own host + the inner <enhanced-select> it renders

D-03.requirement: Full core imports cannot hide the Angular widget
D-03.satisfiedBy: Full core registers `smilodon-select`, which no longer matches the Angular host → no upgrade of the Angular element → widget not suppressed

D-04.requirement: CSR and SSR consumers both considered
D-04.satisfiedBy: Both use the same selector; fixture covers CSR (consumer) + SSR (hydration); SSR serialized tag updated

D-05.satisfiedBy: Selector change does not alter hydration; F01 node-reuse stamp retargeted to the new tag; ngh/hydration flow unchanged

D-06.requirement: S3 typed event contracts remain intact
D-06.satisfiedBy: No change to events.ts / @Output wiring; only the host tag changes

D-07.satisfiedBy: No change to CVA / provenance / touched logic; ElementRef + @ViewChild unaffected

D-08.satisfiedBy: No core change; the <enhanced-select> engine remains the sole selection authority

D-09.satisfiedBy: Explicit: template tag `<smilodon-select>`→`<smilodon-angular-select>`; pre-release → no installed-base breakage; documented here
